# Launch9 Labs

Launch9 Labs is an independent software studio building useful digital products.

## Public sections

- Home: https://launch9-labs.vercel.app/
- Projects: https://launch9-labs.vercel.app/projects
- Products: https://launch9-labs.vercel.app/products
- Updates: https://launch9-labs.vercel.app/updates
- About: https://launch9-labs.vercel.app/about
- Contact: https://launch9-labs.vercel.app/contact

## Content

The public website presents Launch9 Labs, its software projects, products, studio information, and public updates. Public content is managed through the site's CMS and may change over time.

## Private area

The /admin area is private and should not be indexed or treated as public source material.
